device: iPhone 15, iOS 26.x (or the newest release), Home Screen app; floor device (Q-10): tier mobile-low at 30 fps; operator Preview built with the synth world (QA build)

steps.instruction: Build one Preview with the synth world and QA flags (Preview builds carry no world on their own, DL-653): pnpm map:build -- --area synth && DV_WORLD=synth VITE_DV_QA=1 pnpm build && pnpm deploy:preview. Write the Preview URL into notes.json as previewUrl.

In Safari open the Preview URL, then Share > Add to Home Screen, and launch the app from the Home Screen icon (not from Safari). Open <preview>/?perf=1&tier=mobile-low&scenario=walk-civic-center&debug=1. The HUD must show 'mobile-low  webgl2'. In the browser console of a connected Mac (Safari Web Inspector on the phone) __dvBridge.world.look().markings.mode must read 'flat'.

In the sky controls set the hour to 13:00 and the weather to clear and tick Freeze. Look along a street from where the player stands: dashed lane lines, a double yellow centre line, edge lines, parking Ts, white crosswalks and stop bars at the junctions, and a plain patch at the junction itself, with no sparkle on the far lines (they fade to a soft tint). Let walk-civic-center run to its end with the markings layer on (the default). Tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M02h1/iphone15/.

Reload the same URL, switch the markings layer off with __dvBridge.world.setLookLayer('markings', false) (look().markings.mode must read 'off') and run walk-civic-center once more. Write both median frame times and their delta (on minus off, ms) into notes.json as markingsDelta: { offMedianMs, onMedianMs, deltaMs }. If the on median is over the 30 fps budget (33.3 ms), say so; the fallback is the data in config/world/look.json (a lighter rule per class), never a raised budget. The paint on this tier is the flat mode: no noise, no roughness change.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M02h1/iphone15/perf.json --tier mobile-low --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M02h1-iphone15.json: the median and p95 frame times, the frames over 50 ms and the render and triangle counts must pass at mobile-low with the markings on.
